After updating, Google Voice reloads by itself when no call is in progress
Calls are transcribed automatically after they end (server, most accurate model) — nothing to install or download on this laptop
Each speaker is recorded separately so transcripts read Agent / Caller correctly

One-click 'Finish update' in the side panel when Chrome is still running an older version

Recordings upload safely (survive offline / closed tab / restart) and link to the call automatically

Clear message when your admin turns tracking off for your agent

Voicemails shown separately from missed calls
Update notice in the side panel and Settings when a newer version is published
Open Google Voice: OFF badge, button, Alt+Shift+V shortcut and right-click menu
